description: Scala source file defining the InvalidInputErrors object with various methods returning InvalidPlanInput instances for different error scenarios in Spark SQL connect planner.

classes.name: InvalidInputErrors
classes.description: Object containing methods to generate InvalidPlanInput errors for various invalid scenarios in Spark SQL connect planner.

methods.name: noHandlerFoundForExtension
methods.description: Returns an InvalidPlanInput indicating no handler was found for an extension.

methods.description: Returns an InvalidPlanInput indicating deduplicate requires either columns or all.
